effect_description_eng:
[On Play] You may play 1 blue level 3 Digimon card from 1 of your Digimon's digivolution cards without paying its cost.
[All Turns] When you play a blue Digimon, you can suspend this Tamer to place 1 blue level 4 or lower Digimon card from your hand under that Digimon as its bottom digivolution card.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
